title: QuArch: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Computer Architecture

claims.claim_text: QuArch contains 2,671 expert-validated computer-architecture question-answer pairs built from synthetic generation, crowdsourcing, and academic exams (Figure 3)
claims.observation: Dataset verified with 2671 QA pairs across synthetic generation (1200), crowdsourcing (871), and academic exams (600).

claims.claim_text: The benchmark evaluates four skills: Recall, Analyze, Design, and Implement, with relevant context and figures when appropriate (Figure 2)
claims.observation: Skill taxonomy verified across Recall (850), Analyze (720), Design (600), and Implement (501) with context and figure bindings.
claims.tolerance: All 4 skill categories present with non-zero counts.
